conflicts.title: Profile names New Balance 990v6 and 993; the inventory has none
conflicts.profileQuote: New Balance is the spine: the 990v4 and 990v6 chosen on their merits rather than by habit, with the 993 a genuine complement.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Sneakers in the sheet: NB 990v4 — grey (size UK 8.5) [Active]; NB 990v4 — navy (size UK 8.5) [Active]; NB 990v4 — olive/cream (size UK 8.5) [Active].
conflicts.importerAction: No 990v6 or 993 was created: a garment exists only when the inventory or the owner says so. The 990v6 exclusion is still recorded in the healing restriction, so one added later is excluded automatically.

conflicts.title: Sheet shows welted shoes and a boot in rotation ("Breaking in"); the profile's sneakers-only restriction is newer
conflicts.profileQuote: **Sneakers only, until he says his feet have healed.**
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Clifford boot (size UK 9) [Breaking in]; Paraboot Michael Cerf (size UK 8.5) [Breaking in]; Paraboot Reims — noir (black) (size UK 8.5) [Breaking in]; Paraboot Reims — café/marron (size UK 8.5) [Breaking in]
conflicts.importerAction: All are imported as owned and kept out of every recommendation by the active healing restriction. The restriction is lifted only by the owner's explicit statement; the sheet's older status does not lift it.

conflicts.title: A shoe is not the profile's UK 8.5
conflicts.profileQuote: Footwear: UK 8.5 across sneakers and Paraboot alike.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Clifford boot (size UK 9) [Breaking in]. The sheet's own note explains the boot runs small.
conflicts.importerAction: Sizes imported as stated per garment; the profile's 8.5 is kept as the dated body fact. A maker-specific size is not treated as a contradiction of the body fact.

conflicts.title: Drake's jackets in sizes other than the profile's 46
conflicts.profileQuote: Jackets and coats: 46 at Drake's, including Games blazers, chores and macs.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Camel Field Games (size 48) [Active (a bit large)]; Drake's Navy Cotton-Linen Games Mk.IV (size 48) [Active]; Drake's Navy Cotton-Linen Raglan Work Coat (size 44) [Active]; Drake's Navy Herringbone Games Mk.I (size 48) [Active (a bit large)]; Drake's Waxed Chasseur (size 44) [Active]
conflicts.importerAction: Imported with their stated sizes and the sheet's planning status. Nothing was benched or retired on the strength of the profile's size alone.

conflicts.title: Private White pieces are sizes 7 and 8; the profile's current size is 6 / XL
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: PWVC Belted Safari (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Cashmere Cord Bark (size 7) [Active]; PWVC Cord Craftsman (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC General's Overcoat (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Harris Tweed Marylebone (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Loden Cuddler Lumber (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Manchester Peacoat (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Observer Jacket (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Overlord Jacket (size 8) [Benched (too large; tailoring candidate)]; PWVC Richmond Revere (size 7) [Active]
conflicts.importerAction: Imported as stated: the size 8 pieces keep the sheet's 'Benched (too large)' exclusion; the size 7 pieces stay active as the sheet says. Whether the 7s still fit is the owner's call.

conflicts.title: Profile says Games blazers, a jungle jacket and rugbies were sold; the sheet still lists Games blazers and a jungle jacket
conflicts.profileQuote: He sold Games blazers, a jungle jacket and rugbies because they no longer fit, and he wants those same categories back in the smaller size.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Camel Field Games (size 48) [Active (a bit large)]; Drake's Navy Cotton-Linen Games Mk.IV (size 48) [Active]; Drake's Navy Herringbone Games Mk.I (size 48) [Active (a bit large)]; Drake's Tobacco Summer Moleskin Games Mk.I (size 46) [Active]; Drake's Olive Jungle Jacket (size 46) [Active]. The sheet lists no rugby shirts at all.
conflicts.importerAction: All listed pieces are imported as owned with the sheet's status, because the profile does not say WHICH pieces left and the sheet may predate or postdate the sale. No disposal was recorded and no rugby was created. The owner retires whatever has actually gone.

conflicts.title: An active moleskin jacket; the profile lists moleskin among the surfaces that repel
conflicts.profileQuote: sealed or napped surfaces, moleskin included
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Tobacco Summer Moleskin Games Mk.I (size 46) [Active]
conflicts.importerAction: Imported as stated (active). The hand-feel passage stays in the profile for the assistant; no planning policy was changed on its strength.

conflicts.title: A shirt with fused cuffs; the profile requires sewn collars and cuffs
conflicts.profileQuote: Collars and cuffs must be sewn, never fused
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Cotton-linen twill — Canclini sunwashed (size MTM) [Active (layering tier)]
conflicts.importerAction: Imported as the sheet has it (layering tier). Consistent with the profile's verdict rather than contrary to it; recorded so purchase advice can cite the experience.

conflicts.title: Garments and categories the profile describes that are not in the inventory
conflicts.profileQuote: The range runs from a white tee, jeans and a cardigan at the quiet end to a panelled rugby at the loud end, and both are him.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Not found in the sheet: rugby shirts; knitwear (Shetland, cardigan, cashmere); a white tee; light, mid or dark blue jeans; an active tweed, houndstooth or Donegal academic blazer; an active loden or mac. Denim trousers present: Denim — light olive [Active]; Denim — white [Active].
conflicts.importerAction: Nothing was created for them. The profile's prose is kept in full as taste context; recommendations can only use garments that exist in the ledger. Items acquired after the May 2026 sheet enter through ordinary intake.

conflicts.title: Counts differ from the profile's round numbers
conflicts.profileQuote: He owns twenty-odd trousers and thirty-odd shirts precisely so that nothing repeats inside a fortnight.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: The sheet has 43 shirts and 25 pairs of trousers (22 distinct garments).
conflicts.importerAction: The sheet's rows are imported exactly; the profile's figures are treated as prose, not as a count to reconcile to.

conflicts.title: The inventory is a May 2026 snapshot; the profile is dated 14 September 2026
conflicts.profileQuote: Second edition, 14 September 2026, superseding the first draft of 30 August.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Sheet title: "CHRIS — WARDROBE INVENTORY (clean master, May 2026)". Latest acquisition date in the sheet: 2026-05-19.
conflicts.importerAction: Rows are imported as historical evidence of ownership. Cleanliness was never observed, so every laundered garment starts as an estimate; no wear history is imported or invented; purchases and disposals after the snapshot are unknown until the owner reports them.

conflicts.title: The sheet flags one of its own rows as mislabelled
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: Drake's Waxed Chasseur: item says waxed cotton; source detail says "DRAKE'S cotton-twill chore jacket in green (sale)"
conflicts.importerAction: Imported under the sheet's corrected name; the mislabelled product name is kept as an alias so either phrase finds the same garment.

conflicts.title: Sheet temperature ranges do not say whether they mean the morning or the daytime peak
conflicts.profileQuote: Shirts and trousers are chosen against the day's *peak* temperature, never the morning low.
conflicts.inventoryEvidence: 20 garments carry a numeric range in the Season column (for example "To 22°C", "10-24°C", "30°C+ only").
conflicts.importerAction: The numbers are stored with basis 'unsettled' rather than silently choosing morning or peak. The research-derived thresholds in specification section 7 (cotton-linen 28, pure linen 30, oxford floor 10, outerwear ceiling 24, alpaca 12) are recorded as rules pending reconciliation, not enforced.
